title: Self-Evolving Dual-Role Deliberation for Medication Recommendation from Clinical Records
abstract: arXiv:2611.18615v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommending medications from electronic health records (EHRs) is a safety-critical task that demands therapeutic coverage, explicit safety constraints, traceable justification, and continual adaptivity. Supervised neural models freeze at deployment and cannot reason about new phenotypes, while existing LLM pipelines are single-pass and lack a cross-case improvement loop. We propose SEMPA, a training-free agentic framework that couples a Proposer with a Critic in multi-round adversarial deliberation, grounds candidates with molecular-aware retrieval, contrastively evolves both agents' natural-language policies under a semantic-anchor constraint, and enforces rule-based DDI and contraindication checks. On 100 MIMIC-IV encounters, SEMPA reaches 0.3116 Jaccard, 0.7295 F1, and a 0.0172 DDI rate, improving F1 by 57.7% and cutting DDI by 77.5% over the strongest supervised baseline. translated_title: 面向临床记录药物推荐的自进化双角色协商框架
translated_abstract: 从电子健康记录（EHR）中推荐药物是一项安全关键型任务，要求具备治疗覆盖度、明确的安全约束、可追溯的推理依据以及持续的适应能力。监督式神经模型在部署后即被冻结，无法对新表型进行推理，而现有的LLM流水线均为单次执行，缺乏跨病例的改进循环。我们提出SEMPA，这是一个无需训练的智能体框架，它将提议者与批评者耦合在多轮对抗性协商中，通过分子感知检索对候选药物进行落地，在语义锚定约束下对比式地演化两个智能体的自然语言策略，并强制执行基于规则的药物相互作用（DDI）和禁忌症检查。在100例MIMIC-IV病例上，SEMPA达到了0.3116的Jaccard系数、0.7295的F1分数和0.0172的DDI率，与最强的监督基线相比，F1提升了57.7%，DDI率降低了77.5%。两个LLM评审均将SEMPA评为最优，六种骨干模型的研究（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SEMPA是一个无需训练的双智能体药物推荐框架，通过提议者与批评者的多轮对抗协商、自然语言策略的自进化以及基于规则的药物相互作用与禁忌症安全检查，显著提升了从临床记录推荐药物的准确性（F1提升57.7%）和安全性（DDI率降低77.5%）。
en_tdlr: SEMPA is a training-free dual-agent framework that achieves safer and more accurate medication recommendation from clinical records through multi-round adversarial deliberation between a Proposer and a Critic, self-evolving natural-language policies, and rule-based DDI and contraindication checks, improving F1 by 57.7% and reducing DDI rate by 77.5%.
